extracted.name: Burrata Salad
extracted.description: This burrata salad recipe is a show-stopping summer side dish! Inspired by a classic Caprese salad, it features juicy tomatoes, fresh basil and basil pesto, and creamy burrata cheese. Because this recipe is so simple, it's best with high-quality ingredients. It especially shines in July and August, when tomatoes are at their peak.
ingredient_lines: Fresh basil or mint leaves (for garnish)
instruction_lines: Arrange the heirloom tomatoes on a large serving platter.
In a medium bowl, toss the cherry tomatoes with a drizzle of olive oil, the balsamic vinegar, and pinches of flaky salt and pepper. Sprinkle the cherry tomatoes onto the platter.
Tear the burrata into pieces and arrange evenly on top of the tomatoes. Sprinkle the salad with flaky salt and several grinds of pepper.
Dollop the pesto onto the salad, then drizzle with olive oil. Garnish with basil, season to taste, and serve.
